properties.name: 1. Crossing the Yalu or Tumen
properties.note: Most people cross a river into China, usually with a paid broker.

properties.name: 2. Hiding in northeast China
properties.note: No legal status. If caught, sent back. Many spend years here.

properties.name: 3. Through southern China
properties.note: Days of buses and trains past ID checkpoints and facial recognition.

properties.name: 4. Laos
properties.note: Jungle and river crossings, often at night.

properties.name: 5. Thailand
properties.note: Escapees can turn themselves in and are transferred to South Korea.

properties.name: 6. Seoul
properties.note: Three months at the Hanawon resettlement center, then citizenship.
